newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Sogecable in deal with Universal studios.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Sogecable in deal with Universal studios.

text.p: Spanish pay television group Sogecable said it had reached a deal with Universal Studios over film and "pay per view" rights and a new action-suspense channel.
In a statement issued on Saturday, Sogecable said the deal would allow it to broadcast Universal films on pay-TV channel Canal Plus.
The deal also includes the broadcast in Spain of Universal's action-suspense channel and the rights to "pay per view" broadcasts.
France's Canal Plus holds a 25 percent stake in Sogecable, which in turn manages Canal Plus in Spain.
Universal is a unit of Seagram Co.
